jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Stripe is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Payments Infrastructure team. You will design, build, and operate the services that move billions of dollars through the global payments network. Responsibilities include building high-throughput APIs with Python and Go, operating PostgreSQL and Kafka clusters at scale, and improving reliability through rigorous testing and observability. The ideal candidate has deep experience with distributed systems, REST APIs, and gRPC, and cares deeply about correctness at scale. We value engineers who communicate clearly and mentor others.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Vercel is hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to build the frontend cloud platform used by millions of developers. You will work across our Next.js framework, edge runtime, and dashboard, using TypeScript, React, and Node.js. You will own features end to end from design to deployment, write GraphQL resolvers backed by PostgreSQL, and profile performance bottlenecks in edge functions. We are looking for someone who ships quickly, writes clean TypeScript, and has strong product instincts.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Snowflake's Data Engineering team is looking for a Data Engineer to build the pipelines that power our internal analytics. You will develop ELT workflows with Airflow and dbt on Snowflake, model dimensional data for finance and product teams, and stream data with Kafka and Spark. You will partner with data scientists to maintain high-quality feature tables. Candidates should be expert in SQL, comfortable in Python, and passionate about reliable, well-tested data pipelines.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Platform
jobs.description: Datadog is hiring a Staff Platform Engineer to lead the design of our ingestion platform that handles petabytes of telemetry daily. You will write Go and Python services, operate Kafka and Kubernetes clusters, and define SLOs for the platform. This role requires strong distributed systems fundamentals, Terraform-based infrastructure experience, and the ability to influence architecture across teams. You will also mentor senior engineers and drive the team's technical roadmap.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Cloudflare is looking for a Platform Engineer to manage the infrastructure behind our global edge network. You will work with Rust and Go services, Linux networking, and Kubernetes clusters across 300+ cities. Responsibilities include automating cluster operations with Terraform, tuning kernel and network performance, and responding to production incidents. We value engineers who are curious about how the internet works and who enjoy debugging the hardest problems at scale.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: HashiCorp is seeking a DevOps Engineer to help customers adopt Terraform, Vault, and Consul. You will build CI/CD pipelines, automate cloud infrastructure with Terraform across AWS, and write internal tooling in Go and Python. The role is heavily focused on infrastructure-as-code best practices, Vault secret management, and multi-cloud networking. We are looking for a self-directed engineer who documents their work and enjoys teaching customers through written guides.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Notion is hiring an Engineering Manager for the Platform Experience team. You will manage a team of 6-8 engineers building the editor platform that powers our documents. Responsibilities include people development, quarterly roadmap planning, hiring, and working closely with design and product partners. We are looking for an experienced leader with a background in React and TypeScript who still enjoys getting into the code, reviewing architecture, and mentoring engineers.

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: Linear is looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to build the fastest issue tracking tool in the world. You will work on our React and TypeScript codebase, own the design system, and push performance with instrumentation and profiling. You will write GraphQL clients backed by a Postgres core, collaborate with designers on craft details, and set the bar for accessibility. If you obsess over latency and interaction design, this is the team for you.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Airbnb is hiring a Backend Engineer for the Listings platform team. You will build and scale the services that power millions of listings worldwide, using Python and Java microservices, PostgreSQL, and Kafka. You will design GraphQL APIs consumed by web and mobile clients, operate services on AWS, and participate in on-call. We are looking for engineers who think in terms of customer impact, write pragmatic code, and collaborate across product teams.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: OpenAI is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to work on training and evaluating frontier models. You will build distributed training infrastructure in PyTorch and Kubernetes, write evaluation harnesses, and improve data quality pipelines. The ideal candidate has strong ML fundamentals, hands-on experience with large language models, and CUDA-level optimization skills. We are a research culture: you will read papers, run experiments, and ship into production.

resume_suggestions: Add a bullet quantifying throughput of your Kafka pipeline (events/sec)
Mention any gRPC or protobuf experience, even from side projects
Highlight the payments-related work in the Northwind role
analyses.cover_letter:
Dear Stripe Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Senior Backend Engineer position on the Payments Infrastructure team. Over the past eight years I have built and operated high-throughput services, most recently leading the migration of a reporting monolith into FastAPI microservices on AWS that process 2 million events per day through Kafka.

What draws me to Stripe is the emphasis on correctness at scale. I have spent my career in systems where a 0.01% failure rate matters, cutting p95 latency by 40% through caching and query optimization, and I bring deep PostgreSQL and Kubernetes experience to the team.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my background can contribute to Stripe's mission of increasing the GDP of the internet.

Sincerely,
Jordan Rivera

resume_suggestions: Lead with backend experience, not data engineering, for this role
Add production PostgreSQL experience (query tuning, replication)
Mention REST API design and service ownership
Add a Next.js or edge deployment project to the portfolio section
Quantify the GraphQL API scale (requests/sec, p95)
Mention experience deploying to edge platforms or CDNs
analyses.cover_letter:
Dear Vercel Team,

I am excited to apply for the Full-Stack Engineer role. I have spent the last two years building the GraphQL layer and TypeScript tooling for a platform serving 500,000 monthly users, and I have been a daily Next.js user since 2021.

Working at Vercel means shipping at the edge, and I want to bring my production experience with React, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL to bear on the platform itself. I am used to owning features end to end, from schema design to latency budgets.

Thank you for your consideration. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

Sincerely,
Jordan Rivera
